steps.description: Implement a bootstrap experiment to measure N_c(w) (minimum hidden-layer width for zero-violation generalization) vs. constraint sample count w. First construct a simple linear constraint (rigid, low-dimensional) where zero violation is easily achievable, verify it works with a wide network (anchor point), then scan widths across multiple seeds and report N_c(w) trends. This is a pure ML/math problem — no physical system analogies.
